verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of any plugin system, third-party backend hooks, taps, or overlay mechanism for uv; all citations describe uv's built-in commands (add/remove/run/tool/venv/cache) rather than any extensibility API for third parties to hook into the manager. This is a fair axis for a package/project manager (comparable to pip plugins or poetry plugins), but no evidence shows uv supports it.
